summary: Code Review Round 3 regression testing completed. Found and FIXED critical bug in ChartsPage (fetchPortfolio initialization error). All 21 backend tests passed. All frontend pages working correctly with no React key warnings.

bugs_found_and_fixed.root_cause: useCallback hooks (fetchPortfolio, fetchAgents, fetchAgentPerf) were defined AFTER the useEffect that depended on them. JavaScript const declarations are not hoisted.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Moved useCallback definitions BEFORE the useEffect calls that use them as dependencies

frontend: Login page loads and accepts credentials

Engine page loads with Profit Engine config and tables

Payment success page handles invalid session gracefully (no infinite loop)
No React key warnings in console across all pages

notes: All map() blocks use stable keys (verified no React key warnings)
